# The Himalayan Ramble

> Shimla-based, government-approved Himalayan travel operator running customized trips across Himachal Pradesh, Ladakh, Jammu & Kashmir, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, Delhi, and Chandigarh since 2000.

The Himalayan Ramble plans custom Himalayan trips — trekking, rafting, winter expeditions, and cultural tours — with licensed local guides. The office is at Ground Floor, Rathore Complex, Dhalli Bypass, Sanjauli, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh 171006, India. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 76500 99770. Email: thehimalayanramble@gmail.com. Hours: 24x7. Approvals: Department of Tourism, Himachal Pradesh, and Ministry of Tourism, Government of India.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://thehimalayanramble.com/): Operator overview, seven regions, signature routes, reviews, location, and FAQs.
- [About](https://thehimalayanramble.com/about/): Company history, founder, approvals, and how trips are planned.
- [Contact](https://thehimalayanramble.com/contact/): Trip enquiry form, phone, WhatsApp, email, and office address.
- [Blog / field notes](https://thehimalayanramble.com/blog/): Region-by-region destination guides.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://thehimalayanramble.com/terms/): Booking, payment, cancellation, privacy, and liability terms.
- [Sitemap](https://thehimalayanramble.com/sitemap.xml): Every indexable URL with last-modified dates.
- [Markdown home page](https://thehimalayanramble.com/index.md): Token-light Markdown version of the home page.

## Destinations

### Himachal Pradesh

- [Himachal Pradesh](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/): Shimla, Manali, Spiti, Kinnaur, and Kullu — the operator's home region.
  - [Shimla](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/shimla/)
  - [Manali](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/manali/)
  - [Spiti](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/spiti/)
  - [Kinnaur](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/kinnaur/)
  - [Kullu](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/kullu/)

### Ladakh

- [Ladakh](https://thehimalayanramble.com/ladakh/): High-altitude desert, monasteries, and passes above 5,000m.
  - [Leh](https://thehimalayanramble.com/ladakh/leh/)
  - [Nubra Valley](https://thehimalayanramble.com/ladakh/nubra-valley/)
  - [Pangong Lake](https://thehimalayanramble.com/ladakh/pangong-lake/)
  - [Zanskar](https://thehimalayanramble.com/ladakh/zanskar/)
  - [Kargil](https://thehimalayanramble.com/ladakh/kargil/)

### Jammu & Kashmir

- [Jammu & Kashmir](https://thehimalayanramble.com/jammu-and-kashmir/): Houseboats, ski slopes, and pilgrim routes.
  - [Srinagar](https://thehimalayanramble.com/jammu-and-kashmir/srinagar/)
  - [Gulmarg](https://thehimalayanramble.com/jammu-and-kashmir/gulmarg/)
  - [Pahalgam](https://thehimalayanramble.com/jammu-and-kashmir/pahalgam/)
  - [Sonmarg](https://thehimalayanramble.com/jammu-and-kashmir/sonmarg/)
  - [Jammu](https://thehimalayanramble.com/jammu-and-kashmir/jammu/)

### Uttarakhand

- [Uttarakhand](https://thehimalayanramble.com/uttarakhand/): Lake-side hill stations, the Ganges at Rishikesh, and skiing under Nanda Devi.
  - [Nainital](https://thehimalayanramble.com/uttarakhand/nainital/)
  - [Mussoorie](https://thehimalayanramble.com/uttarakhand/mussoorie/)
  - [Rishikesh](https://thehimalayanramble.com/uttarakhand/rishikesh/)
  - [Dehradun](https://thehimalayanramble.com/uttarakhand/dehradun/)
  - [Auli](https://thehimalayanramble.com/uttarakhand/auli/)

### Sikkim

- [Sikkim](https://thehimalayanramble.com/sikkim/): Kangchenjunga views and the old Silk Route border pass.
  - [Gangtok](https://thehimalayanramble.com/sikkim/gangtok/)
  - [Pelling](https://thehimalayanramble.com/sikkim/pelling/)
  - [Lachung](https://thehimalayanramble.com/sikkim/lachung/)
  - [Yumthang Valley](https://thehimalayanramble.com/sikkim/yumthang-valley/)
  - [Nathula](https://thehimalayanramble.com/sikkim/nathula/)

### Delhi

- [Delhi](https://thehimalayanramble.com/delhi/): The gateway most Himalaya-bound trips pass through first.
  - [Connaught Place](https://thehimalayanramble.com/delhi/connaught-place/)
  - [Chandni Chowk](https://thehimalayanramble.com/delhi/chandni-chowk/)
  - [India Gate](https://thehimalayanramble.com/delhi/india-gate/)
  - [Qutub Minar](https://thehimalayanramble.com/delhi/qutub-minar/)
  - [Humayun's Tomb](https://thehimalayanramble.com/delhi/humayuns-tomb/)

### Chandigarh

- [Chandigarh](https://thehimalayanramble.com/chandigarh/): India's first planned city and the last stop before Himachal on most routes north.
  - [Sector 17](https://thehimalayanramble.com/chandigarh/sector-17/)
  - [Rock Garden](https://thehimalayanramble.com/chandigarh/rock-garden/)
  - [Sukhna Lake](https://thehimalayanramble.com/chandigarh/sukhna-lake/)
  - [Rose Garden](https://thehimalayanramble.com/chandigarh/rose-garden/)
  - [Capitol Complex](https://thehimalayanramble.com/chandigarh/capitol-complex/)

## Signature routes

- [Frozen Spiti Valley](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/spiti/): 7 nights / 8 days, November–February. Ice climbing, snowbound monasteries, and snowshoeing.
- [Kinnaur – Spiti – Chandratal – Manali](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/kinnaur/): 9 nights / 10 days, May–October. Apple orchards, high-altitude desert, and Chandratal.
- [Shimla – Kullu – Manali](https://thehimalayanramble.com/himachal-pradesh/shimla/): Custom duration, year-round. The classic Himachal route.
- [Zanskar Range Expedition](https://thehimalayanramble.com/ladakh/zanskar/): Custom duration, July–September. Advanced trekking and Class III–V rafting.
